# Steledger

> Durable identity and memory for AI agents, anchored on the Emercoin blockchain's
> Name-Value Storage (NVS). This site is the front door; the live service — API,
> MCP server, OAuth, and full documentation — runs at https://api.steledger.com.

## Service

- [Quickstart](https://api.steledger.com/docs/quickstart.md): raw HTTP walkthrough
- [MCP guide](https://api.steledger.com/docs/mcp.md): connect Claude, Claude Code, or any MCP client
- [NVS data model](https://api.steledger.com/docs/nvs.md): record names, ownership, expiry
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.steledger.com/openapi.json): full machine-readable contract
- [Full documentation corpus](https://api.steledger.com/llms-full.txt)

## This site

- [Home](https://steledger.com/): what Steledger is, how to connect, how it works
- [Home as Markdown](https://steledger.com/index.md)
- [Privacy and security](https://steledger.com/privacy.html): what is kept, what is public
  and permanent, how to report a vulnerability
- [Privacy and security as Markdown](https://steledger.com/privacy.md)

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://steledger.com/blog/index.md): Notes on identity, memory and trust between people and AI agents — how to use Steledger, why it is built this way, and what we think should come next.
- [Atom feed](https://steledger.com/feed.xml): every post, full text
- [Prove what your agent knew, and when](https://steledger.com/blog/anchor-from-claude-code.md): Guide. Connect Steledger to Claude Code, fingerprint a file, anchor the fingerprint on a public chain, and check it later without trusting this service.
